newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RJP Electronics surges after placement.
newsitem.headline: RJP Electronics surges after placement.

text.p: Shares of electronic products maker RJP Electronics Ltd surged after the company announced to raise capital through a share placement to fund its business expansion, brokers said on Monday.
RJB shares rose HK$0.11 or 23.40 percent to HK$0.58 in late morning on volume of 29.76 million shares.

"Though the placement price was at a trading discount, the company using the fund to buy into a computor venture was seen positive for its future earnings and that gave investors an excuse to buy," said a sales manager at a regional Brokerage.
RJP Electronics said it would place 100 million new shares, or 16.27 percent of the enlarged share capital, at HK$0.38 each.
The net proceeds of HK$37 million would be used for working capital and for a joint venture project in a computer component manufacturing plant in China, it said.
